newsitem.title: CANADA: Shell Canada lowers posted oil prices.
newsitem.headline: Shell Canada lowers posted oil prices.

text.p: Shell Canada Ltd said it lowered the price it would pay for some grades of crude oil by C$2.00/cubic metre or C$0.32/barrel, effective immediately.
The new prices were listed as follows:
Edmonton light sweet C$198.00/cubic metre, or C$31.48/barrel
Cromer light sour C$192.00/cubic metre, or C$30.53/barrel
Hardisty medium C$180.00/cubic metre, or C$28.62/barrel
Midale at Cromer C$167.00/cubic metre, or C$26.55/barrel
